description: This file defines the CanvasManager class, responsible for managing the display and interaction with a canvas or panel within a macOS application. It handles showing, hiding, navigating, and updating the canvas, as well as observing gateway connections for auto-navigation. It includes functions for session management, URL resolution, and debug status updates.

classes.name: CanvasManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the presentation, navigation, and interaction with a canvas or panel within a macOS application, including session handling, auto-navigation via gateway updates, and debug status updates.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the canvas session with an optional target path and placement, returning the directory of the session.

methods.name: showDetailed
methods.description: Shows the canvas with detailed parameters, possibly creating a new session, and returns a CanvasShowResult with detailed info.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the canvas session associated with the given session key.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript snippet within the canvas session asynchronously.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the canvas session and saves it to the specified path asynchronously.

methods.name: startGatewayObserver
methods.description: Begins observing the gateway connection for auto-navigation updates.

methods.name: handleGatewayPush
methods.description: Handles incoming gateway push updates, especially snapshots that may trigger auto-navigation.

methods.name: maybeAutoNavigateToA2UIAsync
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the A2UI host URL asynchronously and auto-navigate the canvas if needed.

methods.name: maybeAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Performs auto-navigation to a provided A2UI URL if conditions are suitable.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the A2UI host URL asynchronously, based on the current gateway connection.

methods.name: refreshDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status displayed in the canvas controller based on application state.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl(from:)
methods.description: Static method that resolves the full A2UI URL from a raw string, appending platform-specific parameters.

methods.name: directURL(for:)
methods.description: Static helper that converts a target string into a URL, considering absolute URLs and filesystem paths.

methods.name: makeShowResult
methods.description: Generates a CanvasShowResult object based on session directory, target, and effective target.

methods.name: localStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of the local canvas session, checking for index files and existence.

methods.name: indexExists(in:)
methods.description: Checks if index.html or index.htm exists in a specified directory.
